newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - April 29.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post business - April 29.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on the front page of its business section on April 29:
WASHINGTON - Mitsubishi Motor Corp. has replaced the two top Japanese officials at its U.S. auto operations.
WASHINGTON - Even experts can't agree on the proper value or future course of the U.S. dollar.
WASHINGTON - Rupert Murdoch's company, News Corp., has told its partner in the proposed $1.7 billion Sky project, Echostar Communications Corp., that it wants to renegotiate part of the deal.
WASHINGTON - Another beverage craze is taking off in the United States, but this time the drinks -- smoothies made of vegetables and fruit -- are actually good for you.
